"58 Items","Slots","Rank","Gold","Materials","Stat Boosts","Stat Nerfs","Frequency","Action Type","Effect"
"Anchor","1","C","10","1 Ruby, 1 Topaz","-","-","Passive","-","At the end of the user's turn, if they did not move, they gain +5 DEF/1."
"Anger Bracelet","1","C","10","1 Topaz, 1 Sapphire","-","-","Passive","-","Each time the user attacks and does not critical hit, they gain +2 Critical Range permanently. This resets on a critical hit."
"Baldur Shell","1","C","10","2 Sapphire","-","-","Passive","-","Whenever the user gets healed, they gain +3 DEF/1 until end of their next turn. This can stack with itself up to three times."
"Fan","1","C","10","2 Amethyst","-","-","Thrice","Free","The user may push all entities in Cone 2 1 tile away from the user, in the direction of the Fan, or push the user 1 tile away from an entity in Cone 2."
"Illusion Mask","1","C","10","2 Topaz","-","-","Twice/E3T","Free","Foes in Burst 1 are inflicted with Confusion/2."
"Knight's Lance","1","C","10","1 Ruby, 1 Sapphire","-","-","Passive","-","The user's attacks from Range 3 that are not in Line 3 gain +1 ACC. If the user has already triggered this effect, gain +2 ACC instead."
"Nightmare Grimoire","1","C","10","1 Ruby, 1 Amethyst","-","-","Twice/EoT","Free","The user selects a move of a foe in Range 4. The move cannot be Level 1, Basic, EX, or a Trigger action. The next time that foe uses the move, they are inflicted with Seal/1."
"Quartz Bracelet","1","C","10","2 Ruby","+4 PD/MD","-2 A/M","Passive","-","-"
"Soul Orb","1","C","10","1 Ruby, 1 Pearl","-","-","EoT","Trigger","Before attacking, the player may choose to sacrifice up to 5 HP to gain +DMG this turn for each HP sacrificed."
"Sparkling Chainmail","1","C","10","1 Sapphire, 1 Pearl","+5 HP
+2 PD/MD","-1 MP","Passive","-","-"

"Amethyst Amulet","1","B","75","10 Amethyst, 2 Topaz, 2 Sapphire","+4 A/M","-10 HP","Passive","-","-"
"Battle Dome Encyclopedia, Vol. 4","1","B","75","7 Amethyst, 3 Sapphire, 1 Diamond","-","-","Once","Trigger","If the user has access to Level 10 abilities but has not used them, they lose such abilities to gain a random weapon's Level 1-3 abilities. The new abilities add the user's higher offensive stat instead of the damage type's. (Abilities that reference ""start of the game"" or ""first turn"" activate when they are obtained.)"
"Billhook","1","B","75","5 Pearl, 4 Emerald, 5 Sapphire","-","-","EoT","Reaction","This may be used when the user hits a foe in Melee. For one round, that foe is inflicted with 5 Cripple and their Backstep penalty is increased to -4 MP."
"Bone Flute","1","B","75","5 Jade, 4 Pearl, 4 Ruby","-","-","Twice/EoT","Free","1 / Self or Ally / Homing 6. If the target dies in the next round, the foe who hit them last is inflicted with 5 Curse/1 and Seal/1. If the target does not die, they heal 10 HP and gain +5 DEF/1 instead. This may only used on a target who is below 50% HP."
"Celestial Scales","1","B","75","4 Pearl, 4 Emerald, 3 Ruby, 3 Sapphire","-","-","EoT","Reaction","This can be used when a foe who the user attacked last turn ends their movement action outside the user's melee and further away from the user than they started. The user heals 5 HP and gains +1 ACC/1 and +5 ATK/MAG/1."
"Fairy Dice","1","B","75","8 Jade, 6 Topaz","-","-","EoT","Trigger","This may be used after the user's damage roll. The user removes up to three of the rolled dice and heals their total value in HP."
"Fairy Wings","1","B","75","5 Jade, 5 Emerald, 2 Topaz, 2 Sapphire","-","-2 A/M","Passive","-","Healing and shields originating from the user are increased by 25%."
"Fighter Sash","1","B","75","8 Pearl, 6 Sapphire","-","-","Passive","-","The user's Basic Attacks and AoO ignore 15 DEF."
"Friendship Bracelet","1","B","75","7 Emerald, 2 Amethyst, 5 Ruby","-","-","Every Turn","Trigger","Select an ally. Each time the user damages or heals an entity, the target gains 10% of that damage/heal as HP. Only one player may have this effect at a time."
"Holy Dice","1","B","75","4 Jade, 4 Emerald, 3 Ruby, 3 Sapphire","-","-","Passive","-","The user has +1 CR (unless they already have +5 CR). Instead of having double dice, critical hits heal the user for 50% of the damage dealt. (This item applies separately to each hit of a Multi-Hit attack.)"
"Hose","1","B","75","5 Jade, 3 Pearl, 6 Topaz","-","-","Passive","-","The user's Cone and Beam attacks have +2 AoE range, but are converted to Beam and Pierce respectively."
"Jade Bangle","1","B","75","10 Jade, 4 Topaz","+15 HP","-3 PD/MD
-1 EVA","Passive","-","-"
"Kitesail","1","B","75","6 Pearl, 2 Amethyst, 6 Ruby","-","-","E3T","Movement","The user teleports up to 4 tiles, passing through all tiles and Foes as if they were regular terrain."
"Mimic Tooth","1","B","75","8 Amethyst, 3 Topaz, 3 Sapphire","-","-","Once","Swift","Targets one player in Melee range. The user either increases their ATK or MAG to match the target's, or to decrease the target's ATK or MAG to match the user. This lasts until the start of the user's next turn. This cannot decrease the ATK/MAG of a Juggernaut."
"Napalm Ring","1","B","75","5 Amethyst, 4 Pearl, 3 Ruby, 3 Sapphire","-","-","Passive","-","Whenever the user kills a foe, they deal 3d10+2 Bomb damage to other foes within Splash 2 of the killed player."
"Nature's Wrath","1","B","75","8 Amethyst, 2 Pearl, 4 Sapphire","-","-","EoT","Free","1 / Any / Range 3. The target gains a random ND effect from the individual list. This effect does not gain ND unremovability."
"Paintbrush","1","B","75","7 Amethyst, 2 Pearl, 6 Sapphire","-","-","EoT","Free","The user rolls 2d8, corresponding to tiles. 1 = Forest, 2 = Water, 3 = Air, 4 = Boost, 5 = Broken, 6 = Stop, 7 = Ice, 8 = Lava. For each roll, the user may choose to place that tile type within Range 5 (ignoring Range Rule). These tiles last for two rounds."
"Psionic Circlet","1","B","75","7 Pearl, 7 Emerald","-","-","Passive","-","When a foe takes over 15 cumulative out-of-turn damage from the user for the first time, they are inflicted with -1 ACC/EVA and -5 ATK/MAG/PD/MD for one round."
"Regal Decree","1","B","75","8 Pearl, 6 Topaz","-","-","Thrice/EoT","Standard","If the user is attacked in the round after using this ability, they permanently gain +5 DEF and +2 CR."
"Runic Tome","1","B","75","5 Jade, 3 Emerald, 6 Ruby","-","-","Once","Free","1/Foe/Range 4. The target takes 1d6 damage at the start of their turns until they do not take indirect (ie. non damage roll) damage between the starts of their subsequent turns. Each subsequent instance of damage deals an additional 1d6 damage. Damage from Runic Tome does not trigger this effect."
"Spellsword","1","B","75","8 Emerald, 3 Topaz, 3 Sapphire","-","-2 PD/MD","Passive","-","After using a Physical attack, the user gains +5 MAG/1. After using a Magical attack, the user gains +5 ATK/1."
"Sticky Hand","1","B","75","5 Pearl, 3 Jade, 4 Ruby, 2 Topaz","-","-","E3T","Free","The user's next Melee Standard this turn becomes Range 4 and pulls the target 3 tiles before accuracy."
"Thorns","1","B","75","2 Pearl, 5 Jade, 7 Ruby","-","-","Twice/EoT","Swift","Choose foes within Burst 1 that are not affected by a status effect. Immediately before their next turn, they take 10% of their current HP as damage (max 20)."
"Umbrella","1","B","75","8 Jade, 2 Ruby, 4 Sapphire","-","-","EoT","Reaction","This may be used on an attack targeting the user, after accuracy is rolled. The user negates and reflects X% of the damage back to the attacker, where X = 5 * (the range the attack was used at - 1)."
"Vampire Thread","1","B","75","3 Jade, 5 Emerald, 4 Topaz, 2 Sapphire","-","-","Twice/EoT","Free","At the start of their next turn, the user heals 15% of the damage they dealt since Vampire Thread was used. If the user is at 50% Max HP or less, this is increased to 30%."
"Wall Goo","1","B","75","3 Topaz, 3 Sapphire, 3 Ruby, 1 Diamond","-","-","Passive","-","The user has +5 DMG and +5 DEF when cardinally adjacent to a tile obstruction or border of the map. The user takes 20 damage when they leave Melee range of these obstructions. HP loss from this item does not affect or trigger the user's abilities."
"We! Yes! Us!","1","B","75","9 Amethyst, 3 Ruby, 3 Topaz","-","-","Passive","-","If there is at least one other alive player with this item, the user gains +3 A/M and -1 EVA. If all alive players have this item equipped, the user also gains +4 CR and dice faces on damage rolls."
"Weapon Scope","1","B","75","6 Amethyst, 5 Jade, 2 Ruby, 2 Sapphire","-","-","Passive","-","When attacking, DEF ignore values and inflicted DEF reductions (including Curse) are multiplied by 1.5x. When DEF ignore is larger than the target's DEF, remaining DEF ignore is converted to +DMG (max 5)"
"Winged Stilettos","1","B","75","8 Emerald, 2 Ruby, 2 Topaz, 2 Sapphire","-","-","Twice/EoT","Swift","Until the start of their next turn, the user gains +1 MP and ignores the negative effects of tile types (except obstructions and Broken tiles)."
"Adjustable Grip","2","B","75","2 Pearl, 6 Jade, 6 Topaz","-","-","Twice/EoT","Free","This turn, the user's Range X attacks become AoE/Pierce X. Pierce X attacks become Beam X. Star X attacks become Burst X. Moves modified by this item lose Splash."
"Avarice Charm","2","B","75","4 Pearl, 4 Emerald, 4 Ruby, 1 Diamond","+2 A/M","-","Once","Trigger"," Choose another player. When that player dies, the user gains new copies of their items. (Items that activate at the start of the game or first turn activate when obtained through Avarice Charm.)"
"Fairy Crown","2","B","75","8 Emerald, 6 Sapphire","-","-","Twice/EoT","Free"," For one round, the user gains Adoration equal to 50% of the healing they receive. At the end of their next turn,  they spend all Adoration to deal an equivalent amount of damage to all foes in Burst 1."
"Flame Boots","2","B","75","10 Ruby, 1 Diamond","+4 A/M
+1 MP","-","Passive","-","The user is permanently inflicted with unremovable 2 Burn. The user only has -1 ACC when Burned."
"Misericorde","2","B","75","5 Emerald, 4 Topaz, 1 Diamond","-","-","Twice/EoT","Free","MR3, 1d8+2, 1/Foe/Range 3. For one round, whenever the foe heals or gains a +DEF buff, they are inflicted with equivalent Bleed/1. If they are already inflicted with a damaging status, that status is increased by this amount instead. This attack ignores outside damage factors."
"Mystery Bag","2","B","75","6 Sapphire, 3 Topaz, 1 Diamond","-","-","Once","Free","This item is replaced with two random non-Golden items. (Items that activate at the start of the game or first turn activate when obtained through Mystery Bag.)"
"Prism Lens","2","B","75","5 Amethyst, 3 Jade, 2 Topaz, 1 Diamond","-","-","EoT","Swift","The user's next single-target attack this turn may deal 1/2 damage to a second foe within the attack's range of the original, 1/4 to a third foe, and 1/8 to a fourth foe. These additional foes are also targeted by the attack. Targetting is capped to a maximum of Range 8 and a minimum of Range 5. (Attacks less than Range 5 have their additional targeting set to Range 5.) If a secondary effect relies on one target, the user picks which one."
"Rook","2","B","75","5 Pearl, 3 Jade, 6 Topaz","+2 MP","-","Passive","-","On their turn, the user may only move themself in one cardinal direction. Once per turn, if the user attempts to move onto a foe's tile with Basic Movement, that foe takes 10 damage."
"Trident","2","B","75","10 Sapphire, 1 Diamond","-","-","Twice","Standard","MR4, 4d8+5, 1/Foe/Range 4 (Splash 1). The user chooses whether this attack is Physical or Magical. They may choose to expend an additional Use of Trident to either ignore 10 DEF or give it Star 2 Splash."
"Twilight Shield","2","B","75","5 Pearl, 5 Amethyst, 1 Diamond","-","-","Passive","-","At the start of the game, choose Dawn or Dusk. 
- Dawn: The user has +3 DEF for each ally and foe in the user's Star 2.
- Dusk: The user has +3 DEF for each ally and foe in the user's Burst 4 but not Burst 2.
As a Free action, the user may swap between Dawn and Dusk."
"Herbalist's Satchel","3","B","75","3 Jade, 5 Emerald, 3 Ruby, 3 Topaz","-","-","Passive","-","After the user is attacked or attacks once with a Standard/Full attack, they gain one ingredient whenever: their turn starts, they take damaging status damage, or they deal damaging status damage to a foe. As a Free action, the user consumes ingredients to use one of these moves on the user or an ally in Range 3:
Mixture (1): Gain +5 DMG/1.
Potion (2): Heal 12 HP.
Toxin (3): Next attack inflicts 15 Poison/1.
Panacea (4): Heal 15 HP and gain +7 DMG/DEF and +1 EVA/MP for one round."
"Demon Pendant","2","A","250","12 Pearl, 4 Emerald, 6 Ruby, 6 Sapphire, 5 Diamond","-","-","Twice","Free","This turn, whenever the user gets a kill, they gain a Soul. On their turn, they may spend a Soul as a trigger action to gain their spent MP back and an additional Movement and Standard after their turn would end."
"Quest Tome","2","A","250","12 Amethyst, 4 Pearl, 8 Topaz, 4 Sapphire, 5 Diamond","-","-","Passive","-","At the start of their first turn, the user rolls 1d4 to gain a quest:
1 = Deal 55 or more damage between the starts of two consecutive turns,
2 = Reduce and/or heal a combined 40 damage from attacks (including by PD/MD),
3 = Move 18 total tiles,
4 = Miss or crit on an attack.
When the user completes a quest, they permanently gain +4 A/M/PD/MD, +1 MP, heal 12 HP, and roll another quest. A maximum of four quests may be obtained."
"Dreamcatcher","3","A","250","8 Amethyst, 8 Emerald, 6 Topaz, 6 Sapphire, 5 Diamond ","-","-","Passive","-","When the user's attacks would benefit from +ACC, it is negated. The user gains 2 Dreams per +ACC negated. As an Every Turn Trigger action, the user may sacrifice 14 Dreams to gain an additional Standard action. This additional Standard action is not affected by Dreamcatcher. Dream gain from non-Standard/Full attacks and Hawkeye is halved."
"Rogue's Light","3","A","250","12 Jade, 4 Emerald, 8 Ruby, 4 Topaz, 5 Diamond","+1 MP","-","Passive","-","The user’s weapon moves have +2 ACC, +1 dice, and are Every Turn (no Usage Limit). At the start of the game, roll 4d10. The user ""illuminates"" Weapon Level moves equal to the dice rolls, but cannot use their other Weapon moves. After using an illuminated move, reroll its dice.
(Reroll if a Level only has Passives. This item does not affect EX moves in any way.)"
